page_title: Best Font Manager / Font Organizer for Mac

sources.entry: RightFont - Preview, sync, install and manage fonts on Mac, Dropbox or Google Drive.

summary.name: RightFont
summary.one_liner: RightFont is a Mac font manager for previewing, organizing, syncing, and installing fonts, including Google Fonts and free icon fonts, without copying files to the system font directory.
use_cases: organize project fonts for a design job
install and try Google Fonts locally in Mac apps
preview glyphs and font details before use
sync a font library across Macs via iCloud or Dropbox
drag free icon fonts into design applications
summary.what_it_does: RightFont lets you preview, install, and organize fonts on macOS. It provides access to a large selection of Google Fonts that can be used locally in any Mac application. Fonts can be grouped with Tags and Smart Filters, and installed with a click without copying files into the system font directory. Clicking a font or pressing space shows its glyphs and detailed information. The page also mentions syncing fonts over iCloud and Dropbox and a set of free icons that can be dragged into design apps.
notable: Installs fonts instantly without copying files to the system font directory
Built-in access to Google Fonts and thousands of free icon glyphs
Runs natively on Apple silicon and supports Dark Mode
caveats: Mac only; the page names no Windows or Linux version
Sold as a one-time purchase, so it is not free
Page does not state the exact price
